messages:
sara: Heads-up — Acme reported 403s from their Private VPC hitting our hosted API after the network maintenance at 03:00 UTC.
alex: link to support ticket? cc @diego
sara: https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-4123 — customer says requests started failing ~03:10, only from their VPC. Other customers fine.
diego: any deploys/infra changes in that window? @sre-bot what did the deploy bot show?
sre-bot: deploy finished: infra/egress-rebalance v2.1 at 02:58 UTC. Note: SNAT pool rotation scheduled during maintenance window.
emily: I see SNAT reassignment for private-vpc-12 in the audit log at 02:59. Old egress IPs: 34.81.120.7, new: 34.200.77.9
sara: customer firewall only allowlists the old IPs per ticket — they didn't pick up the rotation 🙁
alex: can we confirm requests were 403 with TLS handshake ok or application-level 403?
sara: they pasted curl output:

```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (34.200.77.9) port 443
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
```

sara: TLS is fine, 403 from our API — likely IP-based allowlist on their side.
diego: Root cause: SNAT rotation -> egress IP changed -> customer FW rejected. We should have sent maintenance alert about potential egress IP churn for Private customers. Missed signal.
alex: Short-term: can we rebind the old egress IP to their VPC? Or request they update allowlist?
emily: We can attach a static Elastic IP to their NAT for Dedicated customers, but for Private we rely on our SNAT pool. For this single customer I can reassign a sticky SNAT for 1 hour as emergency — will require a restart of the NAT allocator for that VPC (brief connection churn).
sara: Customer prefers we restore their previous IPs if possible; otherwise they'll update allowlist but need time.
alex: Okay emily — do the sticky SNAT. Communicate ETA to customer.
emily: Starting sticky SNAT rollout for private-vpc-12 now. ETA ~6min. I'll post logs when done.
sre-bot: action: sticky-snat:start private-vpc-12 by emily at 03:23:10 UTC
emily: Done — private-vpc-12 now using 34.81.120.7 again. Confirmed successful requests from Acme at 03:30 UTC.
sara: Customer confirmed in ticket: calls back to normal. Asked for post-mortem and long-term fix.
diego: Long-term: docs + pre-notify on SNAT rotations for Private VPCs, and option to buy sticky egress for security-sensitive customers (billing add-on).
alex: I'll draft a postmortem and patch the maintenance runbook to include an egress-change notification step. Also add a one-click sticky-egress toggle in Console (product ticket).
sara: Filed follow-ups: SUP-881 (postmortem), PROD-442 (Console toggle), BILL-99 (sticky egress pricing). Closing thread once tickets created.
emily: noted. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks everyone — good catch and quick restoration.
